(function() { 'use strict'; class ExperientialMarketingAdapter extends USF.SimulationAdapter { constructor() { super(); this.name = 'Marketing de Experiencias'; this.version = '1.1.0'; this.EXPERIENCES = { nature_trail: { costMult: 0.6, emotionBase: 55, capacity: 80, opCostPerVisitor: 12 }, canopy_adventure: { costMult: 1.0, emotionBase: 75, capacity: 50, opCostPerVisitor: 22 }, cultural_workshop: { costMult: 0.5, emotionBase: 65, capacity: 40, opCostPerVisitor: 10 }, night_safari: { costMult: 0.8, emotionBase: 80, capacity: 35, opCostPerVisitor: 18 }, river_expedition: { costMult: 1.2, emotionBase: 85, capacity: 45, opCostPerVisitor: 25 } }; this.PROMOTIONS = { social_media: { reachMult: 1.0, cost: 2000 }, influencer: { reachMult: 1.5, cost: 5500 }, local_partner: { reachMult: 0.7, cost: 1000 }, event_marketing: { reachMult: 1.3, cost: 4000 } }; } initialize(state) { if (!state.domainState || Object.keys(state.domainState).length === 0) { state.domainState = { cash: 150000, brandEquity: 20, totalVisitors: 0, npsScore: 50, totalRevenue: 0, totalProfit: 0, profitHistory: [], visitorHistory: [], brandEquityHistory: [], npsHistory: [], emotionHistory: [] }; } if (!state.decisions || Object.keys(state.decisions).length === 0) { state.decisions = { experienceType: 'nature_trail', investment: 8000, promotionChannel: 'social_media', ticketPrice: 45 }; } } validateDecisions(decisions) { var expSelect = document.getElementById('experienceSelect'); if (expSelect) decisions.experienceType = expSelect.value; var investInput = document.getElementById('investmentInput'); if (investInput) decisions.investment = parseFloat(investInput.value); var promoSelect = document.getElementById('promotionSelect'); if (promoSelect) decisions.promotionChannel = promoSelect.value; var ticketInput = document.getElementById('ticketPriceInput'); if (ticketInput) decisions.ticketPrice = parseFloat(ticketInput.value); if (!decisions.investment || decisions.investment < 1000 || decisions.investment > 25000) { window.mySimulation.uiManager.showNotification(window.mySimulation.t('investment_warning'), 'warning'); return false; } if (!decisions.ticketPrice || decisions.ticketPrice < 10 || decisions.ticketPrice > 150) { window.mySimulation.uiManager.showNotification(window.mySimulation.t('ticket_warning'), 'warning'); return false; } var totalCostEstimate = decisions.investment + (this.PROMOTIONS[decisions.promotionChannel] ? this.PROMOTIONS[decisions.promotionChannel].cost : 2000); var _st = window.mySimulation && window.mySimulation.state; if (_st && totalCostEstimate > _st.domainState.cash) { window.mySimulation.uiManager.showNotification(window.mySimulation.t('budget_warning'), 'warning'); return false; } return true; } calculateResults(state) { var d = state.decisions; var exp = this.EXPERIENCES[d.experienceType] || this.EXPERIENCES.nature_trail; var promo = this.PROMOTIONS[d.promotionChannel] || this.PROMOTIONS.social_media; var qualityFactor = Math.min(d.investment / 10000, 2.0); var baseDemand = exp.capacity * promo.reachMult * qualityFactor; var priceElasticity = Math.pow(45 / d.ticketPrice, 0.65); var brandBoost = 1 + (state.domainState.brandEquity / 150); var rawDemand = Math.round(baseDemand * priceElasticity * brandBoost); var seasonalVariation = 0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3; rawDemand = Math.round(rawDemand * seasonalVariation); var visitors = Math.max(1, Math.min(rawDemand, exp.capacity * 3)); var overcrowdRatio = visitors / exp.capacity; var crowdPenalty = overcrowdRatio > 1.0 ? Math.max(0.4, 1.0 - (overcrowdRatio - 1.0) * 0.3) : 1.0 + (1.0 - overcrowdRatio) * 0.15; var emotionalImpact = Math.round(exp.emotionBase * qualityFactor * crowdPenalty); emotionalImpact = Math.max(5, Math.min(100, emotionalImpact)); var revenue = visitors * d.ticketPrice; var operationalCosts = visitors * exp.opCostPerVisitor * exp.costMult; var totalCosts = d.investment + promo.cost + operationalCosts; var profit = Math.round(revenue - totalCosts); state.domainState.cash += profit; state.domainState.totalRevenue += revenue; state.domainState.totalProfit += profit; state.domainState.totalVisitors += visitors; var equityChange = (emotionalImpact - 50) * 0.2; if (overcrowdRatio > 1.5) equityChange -= 3; state.domainState.brandEquity = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((state.domainState.brandEquity + equityChange) * 10) / 10)); var valueRatio = emotionalImpact / (d.ticketPrice / 30); state.domainState.visitorHistory.push(visitors); state.domainState.brandEquityHistory.push(state.domainState.brandEquity); state.domainState.npsHistory.push(state.domainState.npsScore); state.domainState.emotionHistory.push(emotionalImpact); var _sc = this._composite(emotionalImpact, state.domainState.brandEquity, state.domainState.npsScore, state.domainState.totalProfit, state.domainState.cash); state.domainState.score = _sc; state.domainState.performance = { overallScore: _sc, grade: this._grade(_sc) }; var resultsObj = { period: state.currentPeriod, experienceType: d.experienceType, visitors: visitors, emotionalImpact: emotionalImpact, revenue: Math.round(revenue), costs: Math.round(totalCosts), profit: profit, brandEquity: state.domainState.brandEquity, nps: state.domainState.npsScore, cash: state.domainState.cash, score: _sc, overallScore: _sc }; this._updateResultsPanel(resultsObj); return resultsObj; } _updateResultsPanel(r) { var el; el = document.getElementById('visitorsResultDisplay'); if (el) el.textContent = r.visitors; el = document.getElementById('emotionResultDisplay'); if (el) el.textContent = r.emotionalImpact + '/100'; el = document.getElementById('revenueResultDisplay'); if (el) el.textContent = '$' + r.revenue.toLocaleString(); el = document.getElementById('costsResultDisplay'); if (el) el.textContent = '$' + r.costs.toLocaleString(); el = document.getElementById('profitResultDisplay'); if (el) { el.textContent = '$' + r.profit.toLocaleString(); el.style.color = r.profit >= 0 ? '#2d6a4f' : '#c0392b'; } } setupUI(uiManager) { uiManager.bind('currentDay', 'currentPeriod'); uiManager.bind('maxPeriods', 'maxPeriods'); uiManager.bind('cashDisplay', 'domainState.cash', function(v) { return '$' + Math.round(v).toLocaleString(); }); uiManager.bind('brandEquityDisplay', 'domainState.brandEquity', function(v) { return Math.round(v * 10) / 10; }); uiManager.bind('totalVisitorsDisplay', 'domainState.totalVisitors', function(v) { return v.toLocaleString(); }); uiManager.bind('npsDisplay', 'domainState.npsScore', function(v) { return Math.round(v * 10) / 10; }); } getChartConfig() { return { brandChart: { type: 'line', data: { labels: [], datasets: [{ label: 'Brand Equity', data: [], borderColor: '#2d6a4f', backgroundColor: 'rgba(45,106,79,0.1)', borderWidth: 3, fill: true, tension: 0.3 }, { label: 'NPS Score', data: [], borderColor: '#b7791f', backgroundColor: 'rgba(183,121,31,0.08)', borderWidth: 2, fill: false, tension: 0.3, borderDash: [6, 3] }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { title: { display: true, text: 'Brand Health Over Time', font: { family: 'Georgia, serif' } } }, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, max: 100, title: { display: true, text: 'Score' } } } } }, financialChart: { type: 'bar', data: { labels: [], datasets: [{ label: 'Profit ($)', data: [], backgroundColor: [], borderColor: [], borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 6 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { title: { display: true, text: 'Weekly Profit', font: { family: 'Georgia, serif' } } }, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, title: { display: true, text: 'Profit ($)' } } } } } }; } getChartData(state) { var labels = state.domainState.profitHistory.map(function(_, i) { return 'W' + (i + 1); }); var barColors = state.domainState.profitHistory.map(function(v) { return v >= 0 ?
